s1.headline: Afrika Aba.
s1.description: Yɛnya fi smallholder afuo ne kuw mu wɔ Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, ne Nigeria — aburoo, kookoo, nkuto, ne afifideɛ a ɛwɔ ha ankasa te sɛ fonio ne atɔɔ.

s2.headline: Otwa a Ɛyɛ Sika.
s2.description: Wɔde nsa twa, na wɔde mfidie nso twa, wɔ berɛ a ɛbereɛ paa. Batch biara fa farm-gate quality grading wɔ Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) nhyehyɛeɛ so.

s3.headline: Nsakraeɛ Foforɔ.
s3.description: HACCP ne ISO 22000 adansedie wɔ adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu. Yɛte, yɛpa, yɛwia, na yɛfra — pɛyɛ wɔ anammɔn biara mu.

s4.headline: Awie sɛ Wɔde Bɛto shelf so.
s4.description: Shelf-stable packaging a ɛhyɛ EU, USFDA, ne ECOWAS aduane ahobammɔ nhyehyɛeɛ so. Label biara ka nea ɛwɔ mu no fibea nsɛm.

s5.headline: Aduane Pa.
s5.description: Fi yɛn gyaade mu kɔ w'adwuma mu. Jollof spice mfrafra, kookoo a wɔakɔ no, bankye muhumuhu — nnuane a ɛho hia, a ɛwɔ amammerɛ mu, ne aduane a wɔasiesie.

s6.headline: Ma wiase.
s6.description: Yɛde distribution kɔ guasoɔ 24+ so wɔ Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) akwan mu, ne EU ne North America importers nkitahodi mu.

about.headerText: Wɔ AcresxManna, yɛabɔ yɛn ho ama wiase aduane. Yɛwɔ anim sɛ yɛsɔ aduane ahobammɔ ne pa a ɛho hia a ɛredɔɔso no ano.
about.originParagraph1: AcresxManna Kuw no resesa sɛnea Afrika di aduane na ɛma wiase nso di. Yɛyɛ Afrika nyinaa agrofood kuw a yɛabɔ yɛn ho ama sɛ yɛbɛkyekye aduane daakye a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛkɔ so, na ɛyɛ pɛ ma obiara. Yɛn nhyehyɛeɛ ka kuayɛ, aduane siesie, sika, media, ne distribution bɔ mu—na ɛma aduane pa ne kwan wɔ agrofood value chain anammɔn biara mu. Yɛn adwumakuo no som akuraa adwumayɛfoɔ ne kurow mu atɔfoɔ nyinaa, na ɛde nneɛma foforɔ, nokorɛ, ne nkitahodi a ɛmu yɛ den wɔ mpɔtam mu ba. Yɛhwɛ sɛ yɛde ɛha nimdeɛ ne ɛnnɛ berɛ adwuma bɛka abɔ mu ama yɛahyɛ smallholder farmers den, ama aduane ahobammɔ ayɛ kɛse, na yɛde Afrika aduane ankasa nsɛm akɔ wiase nyinaa. Sɛ ɛyɛ afuo foforɔ, sika a obiara nya, logistics, anaa anansesɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, yɛn botaeɛ yɛ baako: sɛ yɛbɛbɔ nnipa nkwa, bɛkora agyanom amammerɛ so, na yɛbɛhyɛ sikasɛm den fi fapem so.
about.originParagraph2: Fi West Africa afuo nketewa so kɔ wiase aduane guasoɔ, wɔwoo AcresxManna Kuw no fii gyidie a ɛyɛ sɛ Afrika bɛtumi adi aduane—na ɛma wiase nso adi—wɔ nidi ne pɛyɛ mu. Yɛfii aseɛ ne botaeɛ baako: sɛ yɛbɛbɔ Afrika kuayɛ a ɛdɔɔso ne guasoɔ kwan ntam kwan. Wɔ kwan no so, yɛhunuu sɛ ɛho hia adeɛ bɛboro kuayɛ so. Yɛhunuu sɛ ɛho hia nhyehyɛeɛ, mmoa, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ adwuma—fi aba so kɔ shelf so. Ɛnnɛ, yɛn brands boa akuafoɔ wɔ kwan pa so, ma atɔfoɔ aduane pa, na wɔde Afrika amammerɛ anigyeɛ ba wiase nyinaa nkyɛn.
about.visionText: Sɛ yɛbɛboa kɛse ma wiase daakye a aduane wɔ mu na nnipa ahoɔden wɔ mu.
about.missionText: Sɛ yɛbɛkyekye afuo ne adwumakuo a ɛyɛ nneɛma pii na ɛwɔ ahoɔden a ɛyɛ adwuma paa wɔ sɛ ɛde boɔ a ɛho hia bɛka agrofood value chain no nyinaa mu.
about.focusEyebrow: Deɛ Yɛde Yɛn Adwene Si So
about.focusHeadline: Fi Dua So, Kɔ Boɔ a Wɔde Ka Ho, Kɔ Guasoɔ So: Yɛhwɛ sɛ Aduane Pa Wɔ Anammɔn Biara Mu
about.focus1Desc: Yɛhyɛ Afrika akuafoɔ den wɔ kwan a ɛkɔ so ne mfidie a ɛkɔ anim a ɛma aduaba dɔɔso na asase yɛ den so. Yɛn botaeɛ ne sɛ yɛbɛsesa kuayɛ kwan wɔ Afrika nyinaa, na ɛno bue kwan ma kuayɛ export kɔ wiase nyinaa.
about.focus2Desc: Yɛsesa kuayɛ nneɛma yɛ aduane a ɛwie — na yɛhwɛ sɛ aduane yɛ pa, yɛ ahobammɔ, na ɛkora so wɔ anammɔn biara mu.
about.focus3Desc: Yɛma agro-entrepreneurs sika ne afotu ma wɔn tumi nyin na wɔn adwuma nkɔ so.
about.focus4Desc: Yɛka ɛha nneɛma ne ɛha ne wiase guasoɔ bɔ mu.
about.focus5Desc: Yɛka Afrika aduane nsɛm kyerɛ wiase wɔ content ne campaign so.
about.valueEyebrow: Yɛbɔ Boɔ a Ɛtena Hɔ Kyɛ
about.value1Desc: Yɛsesa nyin kwan sɛ yɛtɔ na yɛka adwuma bɔ mu a ɛhyɛ yɛn anisoadehunu ma agrofood nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛyɛ yiye no den.
about.value2Desc: Yɛne nnipa bom yɛ adwuma, na yɛbɔ nkitahodi a ɛbue boɔ a yɛn nyinaa nya na ɛma nsunsuɛ ba wiase nyinaa.
about.value3Desc: Yɛn sika a yɛde si no hwɛ nneɛma foforɔ a ɛkɔ so a ɛkyekye kuayɛ ne aduane nhyehyɛeɛ daakye.
about.value4Desc: Wɔ adwene foforɔ ne akokoduru mu, yɛde nneɛma foforɔ ba, na yɛsesa ɔhaw yɛ kwan.
about.value5: Adwuma a Ɛyɛ Nokorɛ na Ɛkɔ So
about.value5Desc: Yɛboa adwuma a ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛma mfasoɔ nko, na mmom ɛwɔ nokorɛ ne asetena mu ahwɛyɛ mu.
about.value6Desc: Yɛn sikasɛm fapem a ɛyɛ den ma yɛtumi yɛ adwuma a nsunsuɛ wɔ mu na yɛkɔ so nyin kyɛ.
about.brand1Desc: Kuayɛ nneɛma a wɔtɔ ne afuo network fa, a ɛkyekye na ɛhwɛ nkitahodi a ɛwɔ akuafoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ ntam, na ɛma kuayɛ nneɛma ba berɛ biara.
about.brand2Desc: AcresxManna bakery fa, a ɛyɛ bread foforɔ ne pastries. Ɛsesa kuayɛ nneɛma yɛ aduane a ɛwie.
about.brand3Desc: Aduane brand ma atɔfoɔ a ɛyɛ na ɛde distribution kɔ aduane a wɔayɛ ma ɛyɛ boɔ, ɛyɛ mmerɛ, na wɔtaa di daa.
about.brand4Desc: Wɔayɛ ma retail, distribution, ne export guasoɔ, na ɛyɛ AcresxManna brand a ɛdi kan, a ɛde Afrika aduane ba atɔfoɔ nkyɛn.
about.cert1Desc: Ɛhwɛ sɛ aduane hyɛ ɔman ahobammɔ, pa, ne mmara nhyehyɛeɛ so.
about.cert2Desc: Ɛhwɛ sɛ nneɛma hyɛ ɔman nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔagye atom so ma ahobammɔ, pa, ne atɔfoɔ ahobammɔ.
about.cert3Desc: Ɛhyɛ manufacturing nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkorɔn ne industry nkɔsoɔ den.
about.cert4Desc: Wiase nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛsiw, ɛhwɛ, na ɛsɔ aduane ahobammɔ ɔhaw ano.
about.cert5Desc: Ɛsi so dua sɛ aduane fi abɔdeɛ mu na genetic modification biara nni mu.
about.cert6Desc: Ɛhwɛ sɛ aduane ne nsa hyɛ Islam aduane mmara ne sɛnea wɔsiesie so.
about.pullquote: Yɛnyɛ aduane nko na yɛde kɔ amanɔne — yɛde Afrika adwuma nidi, yɛn asase honhom, ne anigyeɛ a ɛwɔ yɛn nsa ano aduane so kɔ.

about.workSpan1Desc: Yɛhyɛ akuafoɔ den wɔ mfidie, nteteeɛ, ne kwan a ɛkɔ so so.
about.workSpan2Desc: Yɛhwɛ sɛ aduane yɛ pa, yɛ ahobammɔ, na ɛkora so.

expressions.headline: Yɛn nyinaa yɛ AcresxManna.
expressions.description: Yɛn expressions ne kwan a yɛfa so de yɛn botaeɛ ba — wɔ afuo, aduane, anansesɛm, ne asetena mu nsunsuɛ.
expressions.expr1Tagline: Tɔ Afrika Aduane a Ɛyɛ Soronko, Wɔde Ba Wo Nkyɛn.
expressions.expr1Desc: W'adwadie online a ɛma aduane a ɛyɛ dɛ. Yɛka Afrika producers, akuafoɔ, ne aduane yɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ paa nyinaa bɔ mu.
expressions.expr2Desc: Wɔ African Food King, amammerɛ ne nneɛma foforɔ hyia ma Afrika aduane dɛ kɔ wiase.
expressions.expr3Desc: Yɛn asetena mu nsunsuɛ fa — ɛfiri sɛ nokorɛ nsakraeɛ fi kwan bue so. Yɛgye di sɛ aduane yɛ ɛyɛ adeɛ, ɛnyɛ anigye adeɛ. Nanso ɛnyɛ akyɛdeɛ na yɛde ma, na mmom yɛboa nwomasua a ɛhyɛ mpɔtam den ma wɔtumi di wɔn ho aduane daa.
expressions.expr4Tagline: Afrika Aduane a Ɛma Wo Ho Dɛ
expressions.expr4Desc: Fi nnu aduane nketewa so kɔ dɛ aduane so, HappyMan de Afrika aduane a ɛma wo ho yɛ wo dɛ ba. Aduane a wɔasiesie deda — ɛyɛ ma fie, adwumayɛbea, ne kwan so.
expressions.expr5Tagline: Adwuma a Ɛma Nneɛma Nyin Yie
expressions.expr5Desc: Panem Vitae ne yɛn kuayɛ tumi — ɛkyekye na ɛhwɛ afuo a ɛma aduane pa a nsunsuɛ wɔ mu. Fi asase so kɔ afifideɛ nhwɛsoɔ, yɛde agri-solutions a ɛfata ma mmeaeɛ nyinaa.
expressions.expr6Desc: Yɛboa dwadini ne supply a ɛyɛ pa wɔ guasoɔ nyinaa. Sɛ woyɛ okuani, bulk buyer, anaa trader, yɛka wo ne kwan pa a ɛwɔ commodity dwuma mu bɔ mu.

impact.description: Nɔma biara wɔ saa krataafa yi so yɛ nnipa, mpɔtam, anaa aduane a ɛwɔ ɛpono so a yɛaboa ma ɛkɔ hɔ.

global.description: Yɛn botaeɛ yɛ baako: ma Afrika aduane a wɔayɛ nyɛ adeɛ a efi fie biara mu wɔ asase biara so. Yeinom ne guasoɔ a yɛsom ɛnnɛ ne kwan a ɛwɔ anim.
